title: One tool per kind of task, not one tool for everything
takeaway: Copilot for boilerplate, Perplexity for anything current, and Claude or o1/o3 when the problem is genuinely hard.
sources: The mistake most developers make is using one tool for everything.
Treat Copilot as a fast typist, not a smart architect.
For research and factual questions, Perplexity is often better than any other tool.
Use GPT-4o for everyday coding help, Perplexity for research, and o1/o3 when you have a genuinely hard problem where you need confident accuracy over speed.
